turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you holding up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My dog chews the door frame when I'm at work, and I'm trying a few ideas.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Listen to all of them first, then comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One idea is a puzzle feeder and a frozen stuffed toy, so he has a job while I'm gone.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is a camera with a treat dispenser, I could talk to him and toss treats from my phone.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My sister thinks I should get a second dog to keep him company, which feels like a big leap.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or I could book a trainer to come and look at whether it's boredom or anxiety.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's the full list. Go ahead.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Start with the puzzle feeder and a long walk before you leave. If the chewing continues, the camera will show you whether he's restless or stressed, and a trainer can take it from there.
